```178:183:web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
export function useCreateMemo() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (memoToCreate: Memo) => {
      const memo = await memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo: memoToCreate });
```

- `web/src/connect.ts` — client instantiation (`export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)`, line 197)
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` — proto RPC definition (`rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)`, line 21)
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — gRPC/Connect handler (`func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemo(...)`, line 70)
- `store/memo.go` — store method (`func (s *Store) CreateMemo(...)`, line 109, which delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo`)
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — dialect driver with the SQL INSERT (`func (d *DB) CreateMemo(...)`, line 16, builds `INSERT INTO `memo` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING ...`)

(Equivalent driver implementations also exist at `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`.)
